title: AutoFirma output compared and the format gaps
result: XAdES matched element by element with the AutoFirma CLI (e3a3197); ECDSA for CAdES, PAdES and XAdES (5aad449); PAdES placement, page, rect, text, field, `adbe.pkcs7.detached`, 27000-byte reserve (62a2ba7); RFC 3161 timestamps for CAdES, PAdES (02d3931) and XAdES (7e81fef); CAdES cosign and countersign (fd869f5). Security-review fixes: PDF page-tree loops (5cc6271) and TSA URLs on internal hosts or redirects (20d84c9).
evidence: `pnpm check:ci` passes (1666 tests); `openssl cms -verify`, `pdfsig`, `xmlsec1` and `openssl ts -verify` against freetsa.org OK; structure diffed against AutoFirma CLI `sign`, `cosign`, `countersign`.
